This is the first regular chapter of the [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!]] manga. It was first published in the February 2014 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'', released on December 21, 2013. It is 14 pages long.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Hiroshi Uratane|Uratane]] begins teaching [[Manabu Kadoo|Manabu]] how to play the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game|Pokémon Card Game]]. After several humiliating losses, Manabu finally gets used to the rules and manages to win against Uratane, who has his first loss in 17 years.

==Trivia==
* When Hiroshi Uratane says this is the first time he has lost in 17 years, he might be referring to the age of the card game itself, as when this chapter was released (December 2013), the card game was around that old at the time.
** This would also imply he has never lost since the release of the card game up until that point.
